submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 at 40 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency (91.567%) at the 8 kHz allocated trigger rate among all tested configurations. A systematic simulation study of 15 configurations (3 algorithms × 5 thresholds spanning 20-60 GeV) conclusively demonstrates that Algorithm-L1 outperforms the alternatives across the entire threshold range. At the optimal 40 GeV threshold, Algorithm-L1 provides substantial performance advantages: +5.1% absolute efficiency versus Algorithm-L3 (at its optimum of 30 GeV, 86.425%) and +17.7% versus Algorithm-L2 (at its optimum of 40 GeV, 73.869%). The iterative topological clustering approach with learned calibration provides superior energy measurement and background rejection compared to the simpler fixed-window or sliding-window methods. The 40 GeV threshold represents the peak of Algorithm-L1's efficiency curve (20 GeV: 88.7%, 30 GeV: 90.9%, 40 GeV: 91.6%, 50 GeV: 87.1%, 60 GeV: 77.3%), indicating optimal alignment with the signal energy distribution. This configuration is ready for immediate deployment to meet the Q4 firmware freeze deadline.
